wood.name: Wood
wood.text: Plain wood from common trees. Most things start with it.

stone.name: Stone
stone.text: Rough stone. Walls, tools, the odd sling.

etherwood.name: Etherwood
etherwood.text: Pale and cold to the touch. Nobody agrees on why its leaves grow blue.

silver-ore.name: Silver ore
silver-ore.text: Grey rock threaded with bright silver.

malachite.name: Malachite
malachite.text: Green banded stone. Jewellers and alchemists both want it.

gold-ore.name: Gold ore
gold-ore.text: Gold in grey rock. Worth the sweat.

red-crystal.name: Red crystal
red-crystal.text: Deep red, and warmer than a stone should be.

birch-bark.name: Birch bark
birch-bark.text: Papery bark. Burns well and folds into almost anything.

acorns.name: Acorns
acorns.text: Oak seeds. Pigs, squirrels and a few recipes want them.

resin.name: Resin
resin.text: Sticky pine resin. Seals, glues and burns.

brown-mushroom.name: Brown mushroom
brown-mushroom.text: A plain brown mushroom. Safe to eat, probably.

red-mushroom.name: Red mushroom
red-mushroom.text: Red with white spots. Don't eat it. Alchemists might.

blue-mushroom.name: Blue mushroom
blue-mushroom.text: Pale blue. Grows where old magic runs close to the ground.

crab-shell.name: Crab shell
crab-shell.text: A shore crab's shell, still a little sandy.

sea-glass.name: Sea glass
sea-glass.text: Glass worn smooth by the sea.
